beeb2832-9bfa-5f26-a2ba-fff33af7369d.name: service_master
beeb2832-9bfa-5f26-a2ba-fff33af7369d.comment: Tenant catalog of chargeable services. Snapshot source for bill_items.

25613a58-8e8a-59d1-956f-53b47373d2b3.name: price_agreements
25613a58-8e8a-59d1-956f-53b47373d2b3.comment: Negotiated pricing rules. Resolved at charge time; ID + snapshot stored on bill_item.

8e7320ca-a9ad-5303-be87-6a9431bc6b96.name: bills
8e7320ca-a9ad-5303-be87-6a9431bc6b96.comment: Bill header. State machine DRAFT→FINALIZED→PAID. Amendments via replaced_bill_id.

3d473218-1023-5007-b6be-7574a12c2a14.name: bill_items
3d473218-1023-5007-b6be-7574a12c2a14.comment: Line items. Immutable financial fields once parent bill ≠ DRAFT (snapshot-pricing).

09080b01-975d-5e28-9c36-544c39dae4e5.name: payments
09080b01-975d-5e28-9c36-544c39dae4e5.comment: Money received. Reversible via status=REVERSED. Funds advances when payment_type=ADVANCE.

a698ccf3-bd0e-500a-9700-c44406369487.name: patient_advances
a698ccf3-bd0e-500a-9700-c44406369487.comment: Pool of pre-paid money. available = advance - utilized - refunded.

fb4eb0cc-c1dd-5831-8208-4e888c690063.name: advance_utilizations
fb4eb0cc-c1dd-5831-8208-4e888c690063.comment: Bridge: applies a slice of patient_advances to a bills row.

a8a3c7b4-f896-5fa6-b689-1bd38db35dc5.name: discount_approvals
a8a3c7b4-f896-5fa6-b689-1bd38db35dc5.comment: Workflow for above-threshold discounts. Approve before bill FINALIZE.

9ea05959-fa35-59dc-bd4c-d9e6aef4a815.name: patient_insurance_policies
9ea05959-fa35-59dc-bd4c-d9e6aef4a815.comment: Patient ↔ provider policy linkage; resolved at billing time.

6aedc68c-f56a-5549-9291-422c8db0ffba.name: service_packages
6aedc68c-f56a-5549-9291-422c8db0ffba.comment: Bundle of services priced as a unit (e.g. master health check).

d4a148d5-7d5a-5f3d-bf3d-6f04f472da8b.name: package_items
d4a148d5-7d5a-5f3d-bf3d-6f04f472da8b.comment: Bridge: services that make up a package.

5506dfeb-d004-57d4-af7e-1a88c89c1fbb.name: payment_id
5506dfeb-d004-57d4-af7e-1a88c89c1fbb.comment: Source payment that funded this advance

1754919e-185e-5bb5-9c32-7ef013266f05.value:
Billing Module — 4-phase schema landscape
21 tables. All distributed by iq_tenant_id (Citus).

b1174614-934b-5a79-bbcf-f5563a70f913.value:
Phase 1 — Counter billing parity (8 tables).
Reaches existing prod HIMS OPD counter parity:
service_master, price_agreements, bills, bill_items,
payments, patient_advances, advance_utilizations,
discount_approvals.

0d4fbef6-ba59-5041-a923-66e99d62f667.value:
Phase 2 — Insurance + corporate + packages (6 tables).
insurance_providers, patient_insurance_policies, insurance_claims,
corporate_clients, service_packages, package_items.

6d384222-8328-565c-beb4-d121c5e3bb99.value:
Snapshot-pricing invariant
bill_items financial fields (unit_price, quantity, subtotal,
discount_amount, tax_*, line_total) are immutable once the
parent bill leaves DRAFT status. Amendments create a new
DRAFT linked via replaced_bill_id. See ADR-0025.

1a1d2141-4b44-53c5-b22c-06ab38a057e9.value:
Multi-tenancy
All 21 tables distributed by iq_tenant_id (Citus).
bill_items, payments, advance_utilizations and
discount_approvals are co-located with bills so all
tenant-local JOINs stay on a single worker shard.
